// Ledger: one folio per booking — what was charged, what was paid in cash, what was paid in points.
signal statement(folio: String) -> Map   // Ledger
    // map("charged", …, "cash", …, "points", …, "due", …).
reads      cash: Map<String, Int> [persistent]   // folio -> total paid in cash, cents
               invariant cash >= 0
           charged: Map<String, Int> [persistent]   // folio -> total charged, cents
               invariant charged >= 0
           points_paid: Map<String, Int> [persistent]   // folio -> total paid with points, cents
               invariant points_paid >= 0
calls      due(folio: String) -> Int   reads cash, charged, points_paid
               // charged - cash - points_paid; 0 for an unknown folio.
